player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Say move et nepeg ya onkana ed porma na [macro micro] a walaay numero 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Amin ya index et nepeg a walad baetan na 0 tan 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Say micro_board, row, odino col et anggapo la.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Say manlalaban so nepeg a mila ed onsublay ya micro board.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: The micro board is already won.

game_action.played: Player {player_id} tinmua ed micro board {macro_idx}, cell {micro_idx} (row {row}, col {col}). Player {opponent_id} nansia napaten na ag play ed {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Say manlalaban {player_id} so analo ed Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
